name: pager
title: Pager
description: Pagination with a pill that glides to the page; the row keeps its width while the numbers roll in place.

perf.budget: Plain views; one pill on one shared value and one more per slot for the roll. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The pill jumps and the numbers change in place.
a11y.screenReader: Buttons named "Page 9" with the current one selected, plus Previous and Next page buttons that are disabled at the ends.
a11y.touchTarget: Every slot and arrow is 44 by 44 pt.
